description: Swish is building the next generation of food delivery — delivering fresh, affordable meals to customers in around 10 minutes. We’re building a vertically integrated business across kitchens, supply chain, technology, and delivery. As we scale across markets, data plays a critical role in helping us understand customers, improve the product, and make better business decisions. About the Role We’re looking for a Growth / Product Analyst who can turn data into decisions. You’ll work closely with Product, Growth, and Business teams to understand customer behaviour, identify opportunities, measure impact, and help build a better food delivery experience. This is a hands-on role where you’ll go beyond dashboards and reporting — you’ll be expected to ask the right questions, dig into data, and drive insights that influence what we build and how we grow. What you'll work on Analyse customer behaviour, journeys, retention, conversion, and engagement to identify growth opportunities. Work with Product and Growth teams to define metrics, track performance, and measure initiatives. Design and analyse experiments, A/B tests, and product launches to understand their impact. Build funnels and cohorts to identify drop-offs and opportunities across the customer journey. Analyse orders, frequency, AOV, retention, and other key business metrics to understand growth. Partner with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Operations to solve business problems using data. Build dashboards and automated reports that make important metrics easy to track. Translate complex analysis into clear recommendations for business and product decisions. What we're looking for 1–5 years of experience in Product Analytics, Growth Analytics, Business Analytics, or a similar role. Strong SQL skills and comfort working with large datasets. Good understanding of product and growth metrics, funnels, cohorts, retention, and experimentation. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills — you enjoy figuring out the “why” behind the numbers. Ability to communicate insights clearly to both technical and business teams. Strong ownership and ability to work independently in a fast-moving environment. Experience working in a consumer, internet, food-tech, e-commerce, Q-commerce, or similar business is a plus. What will make you stand out You don't stop at “what happened?” — you dig into “why did it happen?” You can connect customer behaviour with business outcomes. You enjoy working closely with Product and Growth teams rather than sitting only within an analytics function. You're comfortable working with ambiguity and building analysis from scratch. You have a strong bias towards action and can turn an insight into a recommendation. Why Swish? At Swish, analytics is not about building reports for the sake of reporting. Your work will directly influence how we build the product, acquire and retain customers, improve the ordering experience, and scale the business. You’ll have the opportunity to work closely with the founding team and solve problems across product, growth, and Supply Chain in a fast-growing consumer business.

description: Enterprise Bot is the leading provider of GenAI, Conversational AI and automation software, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland. Our intelligent virtual assistants and automation tools help companies increase efficiency, reduce costs, and deliver exceptional customer experiences in industries such as banking, insurance, and logistics. Our mission is to become the world's leading provider of AI-powered automation software within the next five years. We work with leading companies such as SIX Group (Swiss Stock Exchange), SWICA, Generali and others to improve customer interactions and automate business processes using our state-of-the-art Conversational AI technology. Our global team comprises more than 70 highly qualified professionals from diverse backgrounds. We foster an open, progressive company culture with state-of-the-art technology and flat hierarchies. At Enterprise Bot, you'll experience a unique blend of passion, ambition, challenge, and fun. Tasks Enterprise Bot builds agentic AI for voice, chat, email and messaging, and sells it to large enterprises in deals with long cycles, multiple stakeholders, procurement scrutiny and real compliance requirements. Our growth constraint is not awareness. It is qualified, sales-ready pipeline in the accounts we actually want. This role owns that pipeline. You will design, run and optimise the programmes that generate and convert demand across Europe, and you will be measured on pipeline and revenue contribution rather than on lead volume. What you'll own: Pipeline generation Own the demand generation strategy and quarterly pipeline targets by region and segment Design and run integrated campaigns across paid search, paid social, content syndication, SEO, email and webinars Build and run account-based marketing programmes against a defined target account list, in tight coordination with sales Develop the outbound support layer: sequences, content and intent-based targeting that make SDR and AE outreach land Funnel ownership and conversion Own the funnel end to end, from traffic and conversion through MQL, SQL, opportunity and closed-won, and diagnose where it leaks Build and maintain lead scoring, routing and nurture flows so that sales receives genuinely qualified handoffs Run structured experimentation on landing pages, offers, messaging and channel mix Improve conversion rates on existing traffic before spending to increase it Marketing operations and measurement Own the marketing automation and CRM stack (HubSpot), including workflows, lifecycle stages, data hygiene and attribution Build reporting that connects spend to pipeline to revenue, and report it honestly to leadership Manage the demand generation budget with clear accountability for cost per opportunity and pipeline ROI Website ownership You own the website as a platform and as a conversion asset. Product Marketing owns the messaging on core product and solution pages, and Content owns localisation into market languages. Own the website platform and CMS, including the publishing workflow, page templates, governance and release process Own technical SEO and site performance, including site structure, page speed, indexation, structured data and Core Web Vitals Own site analytics and tracking, including tag management, event tracking, consent management and the attribution model Build and optimise landing pages and campaign pages, and run continuous conversion rate optimisation across the site Implement the information architecture and site narrative proposed by Product Marketing, and challenge it where it conflicts with conversion or search performance Coordinate with Content on the rollout and technical implementation of localised pages, including hreflang and market-level site structure Manage external web development or agency resource where required Programmes and partners Run the webinar and event programme, including field and industry events across Europe and India Build co-marketing programmes with integrators, BPOs and technology partners Work with Product Marketing so that campaign messaging reflects current positioning rather than drifting from it Support product and platform launches with the demand side of the launch plan Requirements 5+ years in demand generation, growth or performance marketing within B2B technology, SaaS or enterprise software Track record generating pipeline for enterprise deals with long, complex sales cycles, rather than SMB or self-serve motions Hands-on expertise with marketing automation and CRM, ideally HubSpot. You build the workflows yourself Hands-on website ownership experience, including working directly in a CMS, and practical technical SEO capability rather than oversight of someone else doing it Working knowledge of web analytics and tag management implementation, including event tracking and consent requirements under GDPR Strong analytical capability across funnel diagnostics, attribution, and cohort and channel analysis Demonstrated ABM experience against named enterprise accounts Paid media management experience with real budget accountability Strong written English Comfort operating with European working hours for part of the day Strongly preferred Experience marketing to European enterprise buyers, particularly in financial services or insurance Background in conversational AI, CCaaS, contact centre or enterprise automation categories Experience running multilingual campaigns across European markets, and managing a multilingual website structure SQL or advanced analytics capability Experience in a company scaling from founder-led sales toward a repeatable marketing engine How we’ll know you are the right fit You talk in pipeline and revenue, not impressions and MQLs You can point to specific programmes you built and the pipeline they produced You have killed a channel that was not working, and can explain how you knew First 90 days Days 1 to 30: Full funnel audit complete. Baseline metrics established by channel and region. Website technical SEO and tracking audit complete, with gaps identified. Days 31 to 60: Target account list agreed with sales. First ABM programme live. The two or three highest-potential channels prioritised and resourced. Days 61 to 90: Repeatable campaign cadence running. Pipeline reporting live and trusted by sales leadership. A clear view of cost per opportunity by channel. Benefits Shape a function from the ground up – Build Enterprise Bot's first Product Marketing function and have a direct impact on product strategy, positioning and go-to-market. Work with cutting-edge AI – Help define the market narrative for an enterprise-grade agentic AI platform used by leading financial services, insurance and public sector organisations across Europe. Global exposure – Collaborate daily with Product, Engineering and commercial teams across Switzerland, Spain, Poland, the UK and other European markets. High ownership, low bureaucracy – Take ownership of launches, competitive strategy and messaging, with the autonomy to influence business decisions and work directly with senior leadership. Competitive salary and performance-based incentives – We offer a competitive compensation package aligned to experience and impact. This is a unique opportunity to build a Growth Marketing function from the ground up and influence how Enterprise Bot competes and grows across Europe. If that excites you, we'd love to hear from you.

Headquartered in London and combining company cards, reimbursable expenses and accounts payable into a single product; its future-facing technology enables finance teams to control and automate company spending at scale. The Payhawk customer base includes fast-growing and mature multinational companies in 32 countries including LuxAir and Wagestream. You need to be able to collect and synthesize information to create compelling go-to-market strategies. Key Responsibilities Become an expert and centralize understanding of our buying audience (customers & personas) Become a market expert for our product, e.g. competitor strengths/weaknesses, target audience pain points, tech ecosystem Provide clarity to Sales and Marketing teams on why Payhawk is valuable to our buying audience Oversee the process for creating impactful product positioning, value propositions and messaging. Ensuring this is rolled out consistently and iterated on Collaborate with Marketing and Sales Enablement to produce impactful campaigns and content for the entire customer lifecycle Partner with Product to define the product strategy and roadmap based on market and sales insights Partner with Product on product Design Sprints to research and plan the go-to-market proposition of new features Lead the creation and maintenance of competitive enablement for Sales and Product teams Oversee goals, strategy and execution for new product and feature launches Become a conduit between the Product and Commercial teams to ensure shared understanding and strategic alignment Track, measure, and continuously iterate across win rate, deal velocity, pipeline, adoption, and expansion Qualifications 2+ years B2B product marketing or equivalent experience. You possess a strong track record of transforming complicated concepts into easily digestible and engaging content, including white papers, web pages, videos, ROI calculators, and presentations Proven ability to leverage advanced AI tools to accelerate marketing results, specifically across content generation, rapid messaging optimization, and market intelligence analysis You are an analytical, data-driven and customer-obsessed decision-maker You are humble but ambitious and eager to make an impact Company Benefits Flexible working hours 30 days holiday paid leave Payhawk company card Monthly travel allowance Health insurance Fitness membership Competitive compensation package Regular team-wide events Exchange program to another one of our offices (London, Paris, Berlin, Barcelona, Sofia). description: About Paytm Europe Merchants deserve better from their payments provider: fairer pricing, faster settlement, easier tools, and support from a partner that understands their business. Paytm Europe Payments S.A., is being established in Luxembourg, backed by One97 Communications Limited, one of India's largest fintech groups, with the ambition of transforming how SMEs across Europe accept and manage payments. Following launch in Luxembourg, the business will expand into Germany, the Netherlands and other European markets. The Role We are looking for a Regional Product Manager to join our team in Luxembourg and help turn Paytm's technology and product capabilities into products that work brilliantly for European merchants. This is a highly practical role at the intersection of product, technology, commercial, operations and regulation. You will work closely with our European leadership and customers, and with Paytm's product and technology teams in India, to understand local requirements, translate them into clear product priorities and requirements, and help drive products through development, localisation, testing and launch. Key Responsibilities Own and coordinate regional product requirements for Paytm Europe's merchant payments proposition. Work closely and spend time with merchants, Sales, Partnerships and Operations to understand customer needs, pain points and market requirements. Translate European business and customer requirements into clear product requirements, user stories and priorities for product and engineering teams. Work closely with Paytm's product and technology teams in India, acting as a key bridge between the European business and group development teams. Support the localisation of existing Paytm products and capabilities for European markets. Build the local payments view on SEPA and instant payments, SCA and PSD2 flows, local schemes and wallets, acquiring and terminal certification, and what Luxembourg, German and Dutch merchants actually expect at the counter. Help develop our in-store payment terminal, merchant app/dashboard and online payment propositions. Coordinate product development across internal teams and external technology and payment partners. Work with Compliance, Risk, Legal and Information Security to ensure regulatory and control requirements are incorporated into product design. Support product testing, UAT, certification, pilots and commercial launch. Analyse merchant feedback, product usage and performance to identify improvements and new opportunities. Help prioritise the European product roadmap, balancing customer value, commercial opportunity, regulatory requirements and development effort. Support expansion into new European markets, identifying where products need to be adapted for local payment methods, merchant behaviours and regulatory requirements. Take ownership of problems and drive them through to resolution. Ideal Background Product management experience in payments, fintech, acquiring, banking or a related technology environment. Hands-on experience shipping merchant payment products in at least one European market, with working knowledge of SEPA and instant payments, PSD2 and SCA, card scheme and acquiring rules, and local payment methods such as Bancontact, iDEAL, giropay or Payconiq. Experience with POS terminal certification, onboarding and KYB flows, or merchant settlement and reconciliation in a European context. Good understanding of merchant payments, ideally including card-present/POS and/or online payments. Experience working with technology and engineering teams to deliver customer-facing products. Ability to turn commercial/customer needs into clear technical and product requirements. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Experience working across different countries, cultures and time zones. Confidence working with senior stakeholders while being equally comfortable getting into the detail with engineers and operational teams. An understanding of the European payments ecosystem and regulatory environment would be a strong advantage. Excellent written and spoken English; spoken French, additional European languages are an advantage. Personal Attributes A high-agency mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, willing to take ownership and able to make things happen without waiting for a large organisation around you. You are commercially minded who takes ownership and get things done. Customer-focused, curious and pragmatic, you are comfortable challenging assumptions, working across cultures and functions, and using AI naturally to work smarter and faster, while remaining calm and decisive under pressure. Measures of Success (First 12 Months) Successful launch and evolution of our first European payment products. Clear, prioritised European product roadmap established. Strong working rhythm between Europe and global Product & Technology teams. Merchant insight and feedback embedded into product development. Measurable improvement across onboarding, activation and merchant experience. Product readiness for expansion into additional European markets. Why This Role Matters Paytm has significant product and technology capability, but building successfully in Europe requires more than bringing an existing product into a new geography. European merchants, payment infrastructure, regulation and customer expectations are different. This role will be the product bridge between the European business and our wider product and technology teams, ensuring that what we build is relevant, competitive and works for merchants here. You will have a direct influence on the products we take to market, how they evolve based on merchant feedback, and how successfully we scale from Luxembourg into larger European markets. How to apply Please send a CV and covering letter to: hiring@paytm.eu

description: Overview Connecting clients to markets – and talent to opportunity. With 5,400+ employees and over 80,000 institutional, commercial, and payments clients, we operate from more than 80 offices spread across six continents. As a Fortune 100, Nasdaq-listed provider, we connect clients to the global markets – focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world-class products and services to all types of investors. Whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, StoneX Group is made up of four business segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth. Responsibilities Position Purpose: The Technical Product Manager for the Market Intelligence & Analytics Data Platform is responsible for defining and driving platform capabilities that support data-driven insights across the trading platform. This role focuses on enabling timely, reliable, and actionable market intelligence, analytics, reporting, and decision support for trading, risk, operations, and business teams. The role partners closely with engineering, analytics, market data, architecture, security, compliance, and business stakeholders to ensure data products and platform services are scalable, trusted, secure, and aligned with trading platform priorities. Translate trading, market data, risk, and business needs into clear requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Partner with engineering teams to deliver capabilities for market data ingestion, normalization, enrichment, analytics, reporting, observability, lineage, and self-service access. Support analytics use cases across trading performance, client activity, market trends, liquidity, pricing, risk signals, and operational insights. Define success metrics for platform adoption, data quality, timeliness, reliability, performance, cost efficiency, and stakeholder satisfaction. description: About Us Lanas is igniting healthcare innovation. For nearly three decades, we have connected GPs, pharmacists, specialists, surgeons, and other healthcare professionals with the best technology possible, from trusted everyday systems to new innovative tools that add real value for our customers. Our technology is used by millions of clinical users in over twenty countries. From core clinical workflows to AI-driven innovation, our products help reduce admin, improve access, drive efficiencies, and support safer, more connected care. We are ambitious about what comes next and are building a business that combines deep healthcare expertise with modern technology, strong commercial execution and a genuine focus on improving patient care. The Role We are looking for a Product Marketing Manager to own positioning and messaging across the Lanas product portfolio, working across the UK, Ireland, Australia and New Zealand from our Dublin base. You will be responsible for developing clear, differentiated product positioning, building message houses that can be used consistently across the business and leading go-to-market planning for new products and feature launches, staying with those launches beyond release to understand whether they are being adopted. You will turn customer, competitor and market insight into positioning that Sales, Marketing and Customer teams can use in the field, and build the enablement materials needed to support evidence-led, credible product claims. Reporting to the Global Marketing Lead, you will also own a dedicated share of our UK and Ireland events and field marketing programme, representing Lanas and our products at conferences, trade shows and industry events across both markets. We work AI-assisted by default . Drafting, research and first-pass competitive analysis are increasingly supported by tools such as Claude and Codex, operating within frameworks defined by our teams. You do not need to have built an AI agent yourself, but you should be comfortable designing a strong brief, interrogating AI-generated output and taking responsibility for the quality of anything that ultimately ships. Key Responsibilities Product Positioning & Messaging Develop, maintain and continuously improve positioning and message houses across the Lanas product portfolio. Translate complex product capabilities into clear, differentiated and commercially relevant messaging. Conduct buyer, customer and end-user research to inform positioning and product narratives. Clearly distinguish between clinician or practice-user personas and economic or buying decision-makers where their needs differ. Ensure product messaging is grounded in evidence and applied consistently across channels. Support wider brand architecture decisions through strong product-level positioning and execution. Partner closely with Product, Sales, Customer and Marketing teams to ensure messaging reflects both product reality and customer need. Go-to-Market, Launch and Adoption Lead go-to-market planning for new products, product launches and significant feature releases. Coordinate launch activity from early planning through to market release. Develop high-quality sales and customer-facing enablement materials. Build and maintain battlecards, objection-handling guides, product narratives, launch packs and other field enablement tools. Ensure Sales and Customer teams are equipped with clear positioning, proof points and supporting materials before launches go live. Work closely with Growth Marketing, Product, Sales, Customer Communications and Corporate Communications to deliver coordinated launches. Track how new products and features are actually taken up after launch, and use what you find to sharpen positioning and messaging. Work with Product and Customer teams to identify where adoption stalls, and build the messaging and materials that unblock it. Competitive & Market Intelligence Monitor competitor activity, customer trends and market developments across healthcare technology in the UK, Ireland and ANZ. Build a structured view of competitor positioning, product capability and market movements. Translate competitive intelligence into practical recommendations for product positioning and messaging. Keep message houses and enablement materials current as the market evolves. Brief Marketing, Sales, Product and senior leadership on relevant competitive threats, opportunities and emerging market themes. Use insight to challenge and strengthen how Lanas positions itself in the market. UK & Ireland Events & Field Marketing Represent Lanas and our products at conferences, trade shows, customer events and other industry forums across the UK and Ireland. Help plan and deliver the UK and Ireland events, conferences and sponsorship programme. Ensure event activity supports wider product, brand and commercial priorities. Develop product messaging and supporting materials for events and field activity. Work with Customer Communications and wider teams to capture customer evidence, testimonials and market insight through events. Feed event intelligence back into product marketing, competitive positioning and commercial activity. Support follow-up activity designed to turn market presence into meaningful commercial opportunities. You will ideally bring: Proven product marketing experience within B2B SaaS, healthcare technology or another complex technology environment . Strong experience developing product positioning, value propositions and messaging frameworks. Excellent writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to turn complex product detail into clear and compelling commercial narratives. Experience managing multiple products, propositions or markets simultaneously. Demonstrable experience supporting product and feature launches end to end. Experience developing sales enablement materials that are actively used by commercial teams. Experience using post-launch adoption and usage insight to refine positioning and drive product usage & adoption Strong stakeholder management skills and the confidence to work across Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer and leadership teams. Confidence presenting internally and representing products externally at conferences and industry events. A strong commercial mindset and the analytical capability to turn competitive intelligence into a clear position you can defend. The ability to work independently, take ownership and move comfortably between strategy and execution. Comfort using AI-supported tools for research, drafting, analysis and productivity, while maintaining a high standard of judgement and quality control. Willingness and ability to travel across the UK and Ireland for relevant events and conferences. Experience within healthcare technology is particularly valuable. You should understand the higher evidence and regulatory bar that healthcare-related claims need to meet, including awareness of GDPR, clinical safety considerations and evidence-led positioning. You instinctively check whether a claim is accurate, defensible and appropriately evidenced before it reaches the market rather than after. What Success Looks Like Clear product positioning: Every major product has a strong, differentiated message house that Sales and Marketing teams understand and actively use. Better launches: Product and feature launches go live with messaging, enablement and supporting materials ready from day one. Launches that land : new products and features show measurable uptake after release, and where they do not, the reason is understood and acted on. Stronger commercial enablement: Sales and Customer teams have the tools and confidence to clearly explain why Lanas products matter and how they differ. Useful competitive intelligence: Market and competitor insight actively influences positioning and commercial decisions rather than simply being reported. Visible market presence: The UK and Ireland events and sponsorship programme strengthens market intelligence, customer evidence and commercial pipeline. Consistent evidence-led messaging: Product claims remain credible, current and appropriate for the healthcare markets in which we operate. What We Offer As part of Lanas, you will have access to a range of benefits designed to support your wellbeing, development and working life, including: 22 days’ annual leave 1 paid Wellbeing Day each year 2 paid volunteering / charity days each year 2 half-days each year for dental appointments Contributory pension scheme, matched up to 5% of annual salary Full access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) Holiday Plus scheme, allowing you to purchase additional annual leave Working Abroad scheme Bike to Work scheme TaxSaver scheme Fresh fruit in the office Monthly office breakfast / lunch on the last Tuesday of each month Free onsite parking Why Join Lanas? At Lanas, you can expect challenging projects, genuine ownership and the opportunity to have a visible impact on how our products are brought to market. You will work in an environment that values pace, accountability, continuous learning and professional development, with the opportunity to grow your career within an experienced healthcare technology business directly helping to improve patient care. Lanas is an equal opportunities employer.

description: Every sale in a Suitsupply store runs through our Point of Sale. As Junior Product Manager – POS, you will help run and improve the software our store teams use every day, from the first scan of a garment to payment, returns, alterations and shipping an item to a customer's home. You will work in a small squad inside the Commerce Platform domain, translating what store teams need into a prioritised backlog and getting it live in 100+ stores — through configuration, vendor release trains and close work with engineering. This is a hands-on role for someone early in their product career: you start close to delivery and to the shop floor, and grow into owning the POS roadmap as you build depth in the domain. What You Will Do Own the day-to-day delivery of the POS product: identify user gaps, define requirements and translate them into clear user stories for engineers and AI agents, aligning improvements with stakeholders and vendors. Be the bridge between stores and technology — spend time on the shop floor, see how sales associates actually use the product, and turn the friction you find into prioritised improvements. Manage the POS Content Management System: configure POS settings, layouts, integrations, checkout options, and use it as your fastest lever to improve the day-to-day experience for associates — you will be trained on the system as part of your onboarding. Manage our POS vendors and integration partners day to day — tracking feature requests, release trains and bug fixes, and holding them to what was agreed — you will step into these relationships alongside the wider POS team. Stakeholder management — you will work closely with store operations and other IT teams, investigate and prioritise the different change requests. Grow into ownership: as your domain knowledge builds, take on more of the POS roadmap itself — business cases, KPIs and the longer-term direction of in-store technology, with guidance along the way. Who You Are 2–4 years of experience in a regional role or digital projects, retail, or a strong affinity with digital tools and workflows. Comfortable in the detail: you write crisp requirements, chase the last open question, and keep many moving parts organised without leaning on process overhead. Hands-on with configuration — you won't write code, but you are eager to learn the configuration tools and understand how systems connect, so you can make real change. Improvement-focused: you look for where store technology can remove friction, give associates time back, and drive revenue. AI-native mindset: you want to work smarter, not harder — you make use of AI tools like Claude or Cursor to improve efficiency, create dashboards and analyse data. No prior Product Management experience is required - we will support you in learning how to work with engineers, Agile processes, and product tools. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience. What You Will Get Autonomy: We empower you to take ownership, make meaningful decisions, and drive impact close to our stores and customers. Growth: You will develop within a high-performance digital product environment, increasing your business impact and decision scope over time. Corporate Social Responsibility: Our commitment to sustainability and ethical business is unwavering. We work exclusively with suppliers who uphold the highest standards, in alignment with the International Labour Organization. Style: Immerse yourself in a world of beautifully crafted, high-quality products, and enjoy a 40% discount on Suitsupply products. Compensation: We offer a competitive salary of €55,000 - €71,000 annually, based on relevant skills and experience.

description: We’re recruiting a Product Marketing Manager on behalf of an established healthcare technology business based in Dublin. Our client develops technology used by healthcare professionals to make day-to-day clinical work more efficient, reduce administrative workload and support better access to care. They’re continuing to invest in their product offering, including newer AI-enabled capabilities, and are looking for someone to strengthen how those products are positioned, launched and communicated to the market. The Role This is a broad Product Marketing role with ownership across positioning, messaging, go-to-market activity, product adoption and market intelligence. They’re looking for someone who can get close to the products and customers, understand what genuinely differentiates the offering and turn that into messaging that works commercially. A major part of the role will be creating structured messaging frameworks across a multi-product portfolio. You’ll also take ownership of go-to-market plans for new products and important feature releases. That responsibility doesn’t stop when something launches — you’ll follow adoption afterwards, understand what is or isn’t gaining traction and adjust the approach accordingly. You’ll use customer feedback, competitor research and wider market insight to give Sales, Marketing and Customer teams practical positioning and enablement they can use. Reporting into the senior marketing function, you’ll also take responsibility for part of the business’s events and field marketing activity across the UK and Ireland, including representing the product portfolio at relevant conferences, exhibitions and industry events. The business makes regular use of AI to support areas such as research, drafting and initial competitor analysis. You won’t need experience building AI agents, but you should know how to give AI tools clear direction, critically assess what they produce and take ownership of the quality of the final work. Product Positioning & Messaging • Own and continually develop the positioning and messaging frameworks used across the product portfolio. • Take detailed or technical product capabilities and turn them into messaging that is easy to understand, differentiated and commercially useful. • Carry out research with buyers, customers and end users to shape product positioning and narratives. • Recognise where the priorities of healthcare professionals and day-to-day users differ from those of budget holders and purchasing decision-makers, and adapt the messaging accordingly. • Make sure product communications are supported by appropriate evidence and remain consistent wherever they appear. • Contribute to broader decisions around how the brand and product portfolio are structured through effective product-level positioning. • Work closely with Product, Sales, Customer and Marketing colleagues so that messaging accurately reflects both what the product delivers and what customers need. Go-to-Market, Launches & Adoption • Take the lead on go-to-market strategy for new products, launches and major feature releases. • Manage launch activity from the initial planning stages through to release. • Produce strong enablement content for both commercial teams and customer-facing use. • Create and regularly update materials such as competitive battlecards, objection responses, product stories, launch resources and other tools required by teams in the field. • Make sure Sales and Customer teams have the positioning, evidence and supporting content they need before a launch reaches the market. • Coordinate with Growth Marketing, Product, Sales, customer communications and corporate communications to ensure launches are joined up across the business. • Review product and feature uptake following release, using adoption data and feedback to improve subsequent messaging and positioning. • Partner with Product and Customer teams to understand where usage is falling short and create communications or enablement that can help remove those barriers. Market & Competitor Intelligence • Keep on top of competitor developments, customer behaviour and wider changes within healthcare technology across the relevant international markets. • Develop an organised picture of competitors, including how they position themselves, what their products offer and how the wider market is changing. • Turn competitive research into useful actions and recommendations for product messaging and positioning. • Regularly refresh messaging frameworks and commercial enablement as competitors and market conditions change. • Keep Marketing, Sales, Product and senior stakeholders informed of important competitor activity, developing opportunities and emerging themes. • Use market evidence to question existing assumptions and improve how the business and its products are positioned. Events & Field Marketing • Act as a representative for the business and its products at conferences, exhibitions, customer sessions and other relevant industry events across the UK and Ireland. • Support the planning and delivery of events, conferences and sponsorship activity in both markets. • Make sure field activity connects back to broader product, commercial and brand objectives. • Create the product messaging and collateral required for conferences and other field marketing activity. • Work alongside customer communications and other internal teams to gather customer stories, supporting evidence and useful market feedback at events. • Bring insights gathered in the field back into product marketing, competitive strategy and wider commercial activity. • Support post-event follow-up aimed at converting industry visibility and engagement into genuine commercial opportunities. What They’re Looking For • Previous Product Marketing experience gained within B2B SaaS, healthcare technology or another sophisticated technology environment . • Strong hands-on experience creating positioning, value propositions and structured messaging frameworks. • Excellent writing and storytelling ability, particularly when translating complicated product information into straightforward and persuasive commercial messaging. • Experience working across several products, propositions or markets at the same time. • A clear track record of supporting both product and feature launches throughout the full launch lifecycle. • Experience producing sales enablement content that commercial teams genuinely use. • Experience analysing adoption and usage after launch and applying those findings to improve positioning and increase product uptake. • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to work closely with Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer and senior leadership. • The ability to present effectively internally and comfortably represent products at external conferences and industry events. • Good commercial judgement and the analytical skills to turn competitor information into a clear, evidence-backed market position. • The ability to work autonomously, own your area and switch comfortably between strategic thinking and hands-on delivery. • Confidence using AI-supported tools across research, writing, analysis and productivity while applying your own judgement and maintaining strong quality standards. • The flexibility to travel throughout the UK and Ireland when required for conferences and relevant industry events. A background in healthcare technology is particularly desirable . Candidates coming from this space should understand that healthcare product claims face a higher standard of scrutiny than many other technology sectors. Awareness of GDPR, clinical safety and the importance of evidence-based product positioning will therefore be valuable. They’re looking for someone who naturally questions whether messaging and product claims can be properly supported before they are taken to market. What Success Will Look Like • Stronger positioning: Key products have clearly defined and differentiated messaging frameworks that commercial and marketing teams understand and use. • Well-prepared launches: New products and significant features reach the market with the required positioning, sales enablement and supporting content already in place. • Real adoption: Product launches translate into measurable usage, with underperformance investigated and addressed rather than simply reported. • More effective commercial teams: Sales and Customer colleagues have the information and confidence required to articulate product value and differentiation. • Actionable market insight: Competitor and market research feeds directly into positioning and commercial choices. • Greater impact from events: Conferences, events and sponsorship activity contribute to commercial opportunities while generating useful customer and market intelligence. • Credible product communications: Messaging and product claims remain accurate, properly supported and appropriate for a healthcare environment.
